observed.titleCard: Your family You are one family among the settlers of Texas in the autumn of 1835. First you make them, in four steps: roll the die for who they are, give the family a last name, name each of them, and choose how the parents look. From the moment the wagon starts in, the game walks you through the farm one task at a time - the house, the field, the crop, the town, the hunt and the well. The country is yours to work once that is done, or at once if you press the X on the guide to stop it. Begin
observed.diePanel: STEP 1 OF 4 · THE BEGINNING Roll for your family The die decides how many are in your family and who they are. It is thrown once. There is no second roll, so the family it gives you is the family you play. 01 · YOUR FAMILY 20 The people who travel with you 02 · WHAT YOU BRING 20 A second die, thrown with it, decides what the family has to start with: a cart, wagons or nothing to haul with, the oxen, and a few reales. One throw. A whole life ahead. Roll the die
observed.meansResult: Hard up. No wagon or cart: an ox to carry the packs, the family's horse, and 3 reales. 1 rides the horse and 6 walk.
observed.surnamePanel: STEP 2 OF 4 Name your family Family Last Name Everybody in the family carries it. It is chosen once and cannot be changed afterwards; first names can be changed at any time, on the family panel. YOUR FAMILY: Anselmo, Charity, Emeterio, Minerva, Andrés, Docia, Effie Name the family
observed.surnamePeople: Anselmo, Charity, Emeterio, Minerva, Andrés, Docia, Effie
observed.surnamePreview: Anselmo Halloran, Charity Halloran, Emeterio Halloran, Minerva Halloran, Andrés Halloran, Docia Halloran, Effie Halloran
observed.namesHint: Step 3 of 4. They are already named: change any you like, or press Continue and keep them. You can rename anybody later on the family panel.
observed.looksStep: Step 4 of 4. Parent 1 of 2. Done brings up the next parent.
observed.looksNote: Choose the portrait, clothes and headwear together. Chosen once, their look stays with them. Children are not asked for; they take after their parents. Appearance changes nothing in the game.
observed.looksStep1: Step 4 of 4. Parent 1 of 2. Done brings up the next parent.
observed.looksStep2: Step 4 of 4. Parent 2 of 2. Done finishes your family.
observed.wagonText: What you load is what the family arrives with. Tools, seed and powder can be bought in a town later, if there is coin; the things for the house cannot be bought anywhere.
observed.wagonWhen: You can change all of this until your teacher presses Start. After that the ox's packs are packed.
observed.stockNo: No stock. The family holds a labor of land, 177 acres, and brings no animals.
observed.stockYes: Drive cattle and hogs in. The family holds a league and a labor, 4,606 acres - about 26 times as much land - and the herd's keep takes 2 spaces of the ox's packs. The family arrives with 6 cattle and 12 hogs, which feed themselves on the range and feed the family.
